**Note:**

Begins with `_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv` file, ends with `-pooled-families.csv` file.

## Load clonal database

```{r}
# Load utilities
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")

file_path <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/18_VecF3_R4_S18_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv"

dat <- read.csv(file_path, header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

Want:

1. `~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv`

2. `~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/20_VecF2_R3_S20_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv`

3. `~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/18_VecF3_R4_S18_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv`

## Derive Statistics

```{r}
## Data frame for storing all results
tab <- table(dat$clone_id)
# Instantiate a counter
counter <- 0
# Reinstantiate tmp_res

tmp_res <- data.frame()
for (nm in names(tab)){
  # Remind where we are
  if (counter %% 100 == 0){
    cat("Progress: ", round(counter/length(tab)*100, 2), "%", '\n', sep = '')
  }
  # Increment Counter
  counter <- counter + 1
  # Subset the clones of interest
  tmp_frame <- dat[dat$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  tmp_frame$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(tmp_frame$junction_aa)
  # Keep the integer as the cluster_id
  clone_id <- nm
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  # Make consensus sequence
  consensus_sequence <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
  # Pull statistics
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  # Bind results
  tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(clone_id,
                                  consensus_sequence,
                                  median_CDR3))
}

rm(tmp_frame)
```

## Identify groups with the same median CDR3

```{r}
df <- tmp_res[duplicated(tmp_res$median_CDR3) | duplicated(tmp_res$median_CDR3, fromLast=TRUE),]
```

## Combine groups with identical median CDR3s

Strategy:

1. Iterate over unique `df$median_CDR3`

2. Pull the `clone_id` values associated with the duplicate CDR3s from `dat`

3. Subset them, tally members

4. Absorb the smaller families into the larger ones

```{r}
results <- dat

for (median_CDR3 in unique(df$median_CDR3)){
  # Subset from the statistics database
  tmp <- df[df$median_CDR3 == median_CDR3,]
  # Subset from the clonal database
  tmp_frame <- results[(results$clone_id %in% tmp$clone_id),]
  # Tabulate clone_ids to find which family is larger
  tablet <- table(tmp_frame$clone_id)
  # Order
  tablet <- tablet[order(tablet, decreasing = T)]
  # Iterate over 2..length(tablet), adding other groups to the top group
  for (nm in as.numeric(names(tablet)[2:length(tablet)])){
    results[results$clone_id == nm,]$clone_id <- rep(as.numeric(names(tablet[1])), each = nrow(results[results$clone_id == nm,]))
  }
}
```

## Double-check

```{r}
dat <- results

## Data frame for storing all results
tab <- table(dat$clone_id)
# Instantiate a counter
counter <- 0
# Reinstantiate tmp_res

tmp_res <- data.frame()
for (nm in names(tab)){
  # Remind where we are
  if (counter %% 100 == 0){
    cat("Progress: ", round(counter/length(tab)*100, 2), "%", '\n', sep = '')
  }
  # Increment Counter
  counter <- counter + 1
  # Subset the clones of interest
  tmp_frame <- dat[dat$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  tmp_frame$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(tmp_frame$junction_aa)
  # Keep the integer as the cluster_id
  clone_id <- nm
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  # Make consensus sequence
  consensus_sequence <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
  # Pull statistics
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  # Bind results

}

```

```{r}
df <- tmp_res[duplicated(tmp_res$median_CDR3) | duplicated(tmp_res$median_CDR3, fromLast=TRUE),]
if (nrow(df) == 0) print("Good!")
```

```{r}
file_path <- gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv", "-pooled-families.csv", file_path)

write.csv(results, file = file_path, row.names = F)
```
